images.filename: Bangabandhu-The-Power-of-Truth-and-the-Futility-of-Falsehood.jpg
images.caption: Image: After miscreants attempted to tarnish the image of Bangabandhu by destroying his portrait, a group of students responded by creating something special. They wrote the words, "A finger pointing to the sky, symbolizing freedom; people around the world, like dew, recognize its essence!" They also created an artistic representation of Bangabandhu on the wall as a gesture of respect.
images.alt: Image: After miscreants attempted to tarnish the image of Bangabandhu by destroying his portrait, a group of students responded by creating something special. They wrote the words, "A finger pointing to the sky, symbolizing freedom; people around the world, like dew, recognize its essence!" They also created an artistic representation of Bangabandhu on the wall as a gesture of respect.

images.filename: 2024-03-25 Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, King of Bhutan, Mohammad Ali Arafat, Sheikh Rehana, Saima Wazed Putul Photo Session at Bangabandhu Memorial Museum, Dhaka (PID-0009604).jpg
images.caption: On Monday, March 25, 2024, the King of Bhutan, Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, along with State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Mohammad Ali Arafat, Sheikh Rehana (daughter of Bangabandhu), and Saima Wazed Putul (granddaughter of Bangabandhu) participated in a photo session at the Bangabandhu Memorial Museum in Dhanmondi 32, Dhaka.
